collections.name: hkp_assets
hkp_assets_guest
collections.viewQuery: SELECT id, property_id, name, location, availability_status, is_borrowable, is_active FROM hkp_assets WHERE is_active = true

collections.name: hkp_borrow_requests
hkp_borrow_verify
collections.viewQuery: SELECT id, request_number, status, asset, public_token_hash, borrower_name_hash, borrower_phone FROM hkp_borrow_requests WHERE status = 'borrowed' OR status = 'return_pending'

collections.name: hkp_borrow_slots
collections.viewQuery: SELECT id, asset, status, expected_return_at FROM hkp_borrow_requests WHERE status = 'pending' OR status = 'borrowed' OR status = 'return_pending'

collections.name: hkp_reservation_public
collections.viewQuery: SELECT id, asset, start_at, end_at, status FROM hkp_reservations_v2 WHERE status = 'pending' OR status = 'approved'

collections.name: hkp_lock_public
collections.viewQuery: SELECT id, asset, slot_start, status FROM hkp_time_locks WHERE status = 'pending' OR status = 'approved'

collections.name: hkp_lock_verify
collections.viewQuery: SELECT id, reservation_number, status, public_token_hash, borrower_name_hash, borrower_phone FROM hkp_time_locks WHERE status = 'pending' OR status = 'approved'
